content:
Danny R: Heads-up, I'm handing primary off in ~12m to @Alice M — quick checklist before I go: PD escalation policy v2 is the one to use (link below), Grafana dashboard names changed to 'inference-prod/*' so bookmarks may break, and I'm missing grafana write perms so I couldn't create the temporary dashboard during the last incident.

IncidentBot: :rotating_light: New page routed to primary — High inference error rate on hosted-api — PD incident INC-7834 — severity: P1 — auto-ack in 120s unless acknowledged. Details: error spike in /v1/generate; increased 5xx and timeouts.

Alice M: Acknowledging the page. I'm taking primary. Quick access check: I can see PD incident but can someone confirm I have the correct escalation rights (ability to trigger SEV2->oncall-sre notify)? @Ben K?

Ben K: You should be good for PD escalation. I checked permissions this morning — you're in the 'oncall-primary' PD schedule and escalation policy. I can confirm you can promote and notify on-call SRE and infra.

Danny R: Ben confirms PD. For AWS: I don't currently have the prod assume-role after the permissions sweep. Ben, can you confirm who has the aws-prod/assume access? We had a gap last week.

Ben K: Right, I ran the audit. Current short list: me, Carla S, and Oncall-Mgr have persistent assume-role access. Others are on just-in-time. Carla, can you share the exact assume-role command we use for emergencies?

Carla S: Use the emergency assume-role with MFA:```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOncallProd --role-session-name oncall-<yourname> --serial-number arn:aws:iam::123456789012:mfa/<your-mfa> --token-code 123456
```Replace token-code with your MFA code. Then export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID etc from the returned creds. Note: session duration is 1h.

Carla S: Also FYI the runbook for this class of errors is here: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall/inference-high-error-rate — follow the checklist under 'Immediate mitigation' and 'Customer impact'. The quick mitigations are: 1) check model pool health, 2) look for recent rollouts (console -> model-rollouts), 3) check KV cache pressure.

Alice M: I can access the runbook. Grafana check: I can view dashboards but can't edit. Is it expected that primary should be able to create a temporary panel for a tracer?

Danny R: It used to be expected but after the perms cleanup only SRE leads have grafana Admin. Primary should be able to view and share. If you need a new panel, tag @Carla S and I'll ask Oncall-Mgr to grant a temporary editor session.

Ben K: Noted. Also adding the dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/inference-prod/errors-over-time and https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/inference-prod/kv-cache-usage — use the time range 'last 15m' and set grouping by model_id.

Alice M: Confirmed initial checks: error rate up ~4x, spike started 3m ago, recent rollout for model x-small at 02:10 UTC. I'm rolling back model x-small on blue pool to previous version via the rollout UI (will update in thread). If rollback fails, plan B is to scale down that variant and route to stable.

IncidentBot: Update: INC-7834 status -> acknowledged by Alice M. PagerDuty: responders notified.

Danny R: Coverage note before I step away — APAC night window (00:00-08:00 UTC) currently has only secondary coverage (Ben on-call). We have a gap for a dedicated APAC primary — Oncall-Mgr, can we get someone in the rotation for APAC nights? This came up during last week's incident and we still haven't filled it.

Oncall-Mgr: I'm on it. Will reach out to the rotations team and propose a temporary swap with infra-platform for the next 2 weeks. Will confirm within 2 hours.

Carla S: If anyone gets locked out of AWS for assume-role, emergency backdoor is to open a request at https://support.redwood.ai/iam-emergency with subject 'oncall assume-role' — ops-sre will respond and we have a documented 30m SLA for access escalations.

Ben K: One last perms action item: Danny, please file a short ticket to re-evaluate Grafana editor access for primaries. I can include the audit log we used.

Danny R: Filed ticket (INT-4521) and linked audit. Handoff: I'm handing primary to @Alice M now. @Alice M — you're primary, Ben is your secondary. Carla is SRE escalation. Anything else?

Alice M: Got it. Primary accepted. Ben secondary confirmed. I'll post updates to the PD incident as we roll back. Leaving a note in the runbook: 'handoff at 1745009012 — primary: Alice M, secondary: Ben K, access notes: assume-role via Carla instructions, Grafana view-only, emergency support from Oncall-Mgr.'

Ben K: Acknowledged. Reach out if rollback needs infra escalation.

IncidentBot: INC-7834 — note added by Alice M: rollback started at 1745009150.

Danny R: Thanks all. Stepping off.

Alice M: Handoff complete. I'll update last_message_ts when incident resolves. :thumbsup:
